Welcome to the Hollywood Studio.

FAQs

What is the studio capable of?

With 32 channels of recording through the SSL console, and 16 channels of analog outboard including high quality D/A Lynx conversion, UAD, vocal booth mastering chain, hearback monitoring, plus a selection of synths, guitars, FX, drums, piano, microphones, and more, the studio is prepared for production, writing, mixing, mastering, show prep, rehearsal, and more.

What gear is available?

Here is the public gear list available for rental along with the studio or for external backline rental.

Where is the studio located?

Exact studio location is given upon confirmed bookings, but the studio is in central Hollywood, only minutes off the Gower / Highway 101 exit.

How much does it cost?

We accomodate budgets for bookings of a minimum 3 hours, up to multi day lockouts. Please inquire and let us know what you are aiming to do with your time and we will provide a quote.

Can I hire an engineer?

Of course! For new studio users, we typically include a basic training session for your engineer, or can provide an engineer at an hourly rate.

How’s the parking? Bathroom access?

The studio only has street parking available, but it is not the worst parking… for Hollywood. The studio includes easy access to a private bathroom.
